checks: Inputs are one hypothesis scene, acquired native scene, fixed pose/intrinsics and acquired history.
The original first intersection is kept unless strictly free under the frozen B2 history rule.
Only contradicted rays enumerate alternatives; nearest non-contradicted positive intersection wins.
Cross-view measured support vetoes free-space evidence and empty intersection listings cannot erase the original first hit.
Current native geometry is never filtered and competes as the nearer first hit.
The fitted sensor convention is axial depth in the explicit 0.15–8m range.
limits: Wrapper must freeze and verify the imported B2 history source hash; empty REPAIR_SHA variable itself provides no validation.
Caller-level distinction between predicted and actual future observations requires separate audit.
This renderer cannot fix inaccurate hypotheses or current native geometry and does not demonstrate full-policy improvement.
